items.stem: If 1500 grams of water is heated from 15°C to 45°C, how much heat is required in joules?

The specific heat of copper is 0.09 cal/(g C) and that of water is 1 cal/(g C). What is the final temperature of the water?

Which of the following is the correct formula to convert temperature from Celsius to Kelvin?

The initial temperature of the calorimeter and water is 30 degrees Celsius, and the hot object is at 60 degrees Celsius.
